title: Controlled Pain Medicine Review Visits — Primary Care Provider Assignment
content:
**Pharmacy safety note: controlled pain medicine and second-opinion referrals under the Primary Care Provider Assignment.**

**Rule.** Medication review visits are added to a second-opinion referral's visits for controlled pain medicine, before the single-referral visit ceiling is applied. They are counted as the member's paid pharmacy fills under the **Pharmacy Benefit** of a Schedule II, III or IV controlled substance with a fill date in the work-up window of **3 months**: two or more fills add the two-visit medication allowance (**2** visits), exactly one adds the one-visit medication allowance (**1** visit), and none adds nothing.

**Which fills count.** Fills whose drug is recorded with the controlled-substance schedule II, III or IV. Fills of Schedule V drugs, and of drugs with no controlled schedule, do not count.

**Window.** A trailing period counted back from the handling date in whole months: a fill is inside it when fewer than 3 whole months separate its fill date from the handling date, so a fill dated exactly 3 months back is outside it.

| Paid Schedule II, III or IV fills in the last 3 months | Medication review visits |
|---|---|
| 0 | 0 |
| 1 | 1 |
| 2 | 2 |
| 3 or more | 2 |

**Illustrations (hypothetical, handling date 15 September 2026)**

- A Schedule II fill on 20 July and a Schedule IV fill on 18 August 2026: two, 2 visits.
- A Schedule III fill on 18 August 2026 and a Schedule V fill on 1 September 2026: one counted, 1 visit.
- A Schedule II fill on 15 June 2026 only: exactly 3 months back, outside; no visit.
